pkgmetadata.longdescription: Prebuilt kernel binary for the NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 Grace-Blackwell), repackaged directly from Ubuntu's signed linux-image/linux-modules debs (ports.ubuntu.com, linux-nvidia/linux-signed-nvidia source packages). No compilation: this is the exact kernel NVIDIA ships and validates on this hardware as DGX OS. aarch64 only. See sys-kernel/dgx-spark-sources for a from-source, configurable alternative.

use.flag: Also install the matching linux-headers deb to /usr/src, for building out-of-tree modules (e.g. DKMS) against this kernel
